## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm check:standards`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` and `pnpm knip` pass
- [ ] A new or changed statistic has a reference and a regenerated fixture
- [ ] A change to a rule that keeps untrusted input from being misread, or from costing what its size does not, adds or updates
  its entry in `scripts/check-rules.ts`
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] A changeset is added or extended for each package that changes
